original.statement: The "Neither --kubeconfig nor --master was specified" warning log message is no longer emitted when the controller and webhook services boot; it has no operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-969cbf095c23] says only that a startup log warning ("Neither --kubeconfig nor --master was specified") is no longer printed when the controller and webhook boot, and lists it under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)". A log line is not wire or protocol behaviour, so the protocol-behavior subject is a misclassification. No other subject family covers a log message, and the --kubeconfig and --master flags themselves are not changed. So no correctly typed assertion follows, and three of the four proposals also found no fitting subject.
